chatDemo.content: Hi there! Welcome to Rosewood Hair Studio. I can help you book appointments, check pricing, or answer any questions. What can I do for you?
Do you do balayage? How much is it?

Yes! Balayage starts at $165 for medium-length hair, including consultation, color, and blowout. Our colorist Priya specializes in balayage and has openings this Thursday and Friday. Want me to book you in?
Thursday works. Do you have anything around 2pm?
Priya has a 2:15 PM slot open on Thursday. I'll book that for you. Can I get your name and phone number to confirm?
